name: Avatar
description: A person's or account's picture, falling back to their initials when there is no image or it fails to load.

name.description: The person's name. It is the accessible name, and the source of the initials.

src.description: Image URL. If it is missing or fails to load, the initials show instead.

shape.description: Circle for people, square for organisations.

decorative.description: Hides it from screen readers, for when the name is already written next to it.

requirements: It is an image with the person's name as its text alternative
With decorative set, it is hidden from assistive technology so a name next to it isn't read twice
Initials text meets 4.5:1 against the background
screenReader: Announced as an image named after the person, e.g. "Ada Lovelace", unless decorative

use_when: Showing who wrote, owns or is assigned something
avoid_when: A logo or product image: use an img
anti_patterns: Setting decorative when no name is written beside the avatar
